en: 1. The Story of the Mansion of the Variegated Creeper Just as the grove of variegated creepers shines forth—
the most excellent garden of the Thirty-Three Gods, supreme among them—
Just like that, this celestial mansion of yours stands illuminating the sky.
You have attained the power of a deva, O one of great majesty.
"What merit did you perform while being a human being?
By what means have you come to possess such blazing majesty,
and why does your complexion illuminate all directions?"
Thus that son of the gods was delighted...
[as before] ...the fruit of which deed this is.
I was poor, without protection, wretched, and a laborer;
I supported my aged mother and father.”
And those virtuous ones were dear to me;
with a confident heart, I gave them abundant gifts of food and drink with due respect.
"Because of that, my complexion is such as this...
and my complexion shines forth in all directions."
